releaseNotes: First Stable release of the 0.3 line - promoted from the approved 0.3.0-beta.2.
The installer now detects and installs the official Microsoft VSTO runtime automatically.
Fixed the STA crash when opening an XER from WBS Style and the report dialogs.
WBS Level Editor columns no longer collapse; layout stays readable at any width.
Update pipeline hardening: anti-downgrade protection with exact prerelease SemVer floor.
